speedupSummary: Package page navigation + snapshot: 9,097 ms (external badge/ad script stall) -> ~610 ms (14.9x faster via commit + hydrationSettleMs); ~40 ms #description documentation read
notes: PyPI project pages embed external CI/coverage badge images that stall window.onload >9s; Browser Bridge uses domcontentloaded (~480 ms).
Use "read_package_docs" (~40 ms) to read full project documentation and pip install metadata, or "search_packages".

read_package_docs.name: read_package_docs
read_package_docs.description: Extracts pip install header and full #description / .project-description documentation in ~40 ms.

search_packages.name: search_packages
search_packages.description: Searches PyPI Python packages and snapshots matching results.
